subject: MSA + Order Form: DPA redlines, SCC mapping & transfer path playbook
messages:
From: Kate Olson <kate.olson@helixmed.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: HelixMed Legal <legal@helixmed.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: DPA redlines + SCCs extract (initial)

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited about the pilot. Attaching the DPA redlines our counsel prepared based on the MSA and Order Form you sent. The main items we highlighted:

- Clause 4.2 (subprocessor delegation): we want explicit list-of-categories + 30-day notice for new subprocessors.
- Clause 6 (international transfers): redlines reference SCCs + a proposed Transfer Impact Addendum (TIA) section.
- Security exhibits: asked for logging retention and per-tenant key management options.

We tried to keep changes narrow but the SCCs mapping may require a short schedule/annex. Please confirm if Redwood can provide:

1) a completed SCCs mapping table (processor/processor vs controller/processor rows),
2) an evidence pack (SOC2 summary, retention windows, KMS integrations), and
3) whether you can accept our proposed language on subprocessor notification (30 days).

Attached: Helix_DPA_Redlines_v3.docx (redlines), Rexford-SCCs-map.xlsx (SCC suggestions).

If you prefer, we can route a marked-up MSA/Order Form back to your legal. Planning for pilot kickoff 8/2 so hoping to close these items this week.

Best,
Kate
Kate Olson
Director, Legal Operations
HelixMed

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: DPA redlines + SCCs extract (initial)

Folks — forwarding HelixMed redlines for legal review and ops alignment. TL;DR: they want SCCs annex + transfer impact addendum and narrower subprocessor delegation notice (30 days). They flagged logging retention and optional KMS.

Please see attached redlines and the SCC mapping they proposed. Quick asks for owners below: 

- Karthik: legal redline pass + comment on whether 30-day subproc notice is acceptable (we usually do 14 days, some exceptions for security-critical subs). Also confirm whether we can provide the SCCs annex as a schedule instead of inline clause edits.
- Laura: product/security — confirm current default retention windows (audit/trace logs, KV cache), and whether per-tenant KMS is supported in private deployments (if not, state options).
- Monica: sales/ops — help me draft an acceptance timeline and rollout plan; they want pilot on 8/2.

Target: provide combined response to Helix by EOD 7/16 so they can include in their procurement review.

Attachments: Helix_DPA_Redlines_v3.docx, Rexford-SCCs-map.xlsx

Thanks — Steph
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Strategic Accounts (West)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Kate Olson <kate.olson@helixmed.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: DPA redlines + SCCs extract (initial)

Stephanie / team — reviewed HelixMed's draft. High-level comments below; inline annotated redlines attached (see redlines-summary.pdf).

1) Subprocessor notice window: We can accept 30 days for non-security-critical subprocessors. For security-critical (key management, logging for compliance), we require either 14 days or immediate notification plus preapproval in the SOW. Propose we: accept 30 days generally, carve out KMS & auth services.

2) SCCs annex: Agree an annex/schedule is cleaner. We will provide a completed SCCs mapping table that references the applicable clause numbers in the MSA/Order Form. I asked ops to fill in the hosting region guarantees and whether any cross-border subprocessing occurs outside contracted regions.

3) Transfer Impact Addendum (TIA): I'll prep a short TIA template referencing our internal risk assessment and the mitigations (encryption at rest, egress controls, subprocessors list, and SCCs). This will be a living annex that we can update without re-signing the MSA.

4) Evidence pack: Recommend we include: SOC2 Type II executive summary (redacted), standard retention matrix, KMS provider options & limitations, and the list of subprocessor roles + controls. Ops (Laura) — can you confirm retention windows and whether we can supply a redacted SOC2 by EOD 7/16?

Next steps I propose: Karthik to send annotated redlines + TIA template by 7/16 noon PT; Steph to consolidate and propose acceptance timeline; Monica to coordinate procurement gating items (billing entity, PO if required).

Kate — copying you on legal's plan. If HelixMed has specific export-control or local law constraints (e.g., EU controller obligations) beyond what's in your draft, flag them so we can adjust the TIA.

Attachments: redlines-summary.pdf

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 15:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: DPA redlines, SCC mapping & transfer path playbook

Kate — thank you for the quick turnaround. Per legal/ops review below is the consolidated plan and timeline: 

- Legal (Karthik) will deliver annotated redlines + a short TIA template by tomorrow EOD (7/19) so you have language to review.
- Security/Product (Laura) confirmed retention windows: logs = 90 days (default), audit trails = 365 days; we can support longer retention on Dedicated with an add-on. Per-tenant KMS: supported in Private deployments; for Hosted we offer KMS integration via customer-managed keys with some lead time (we'll outline exact steps in the evidence pack).
- Sales/Ops (Monica) will confirm billing entity and procurement contact; she will send a draft mutual action plan that lists the signoffs and a proposed DocuSign packet.

Action items for HelixMed: please confirm whether you need the SCCs mapping to be incorporated into the signed Order Form (we prefer annex) and whether your procurement/legal team requires the 30-day subprocessor notification without carveouts. If both are thumbs-up, we will produce the annex + TIA and circulate a DocuSign packet for the MSA + Order Form + DPA by 7/23.

For traceability I attached the internal redlines summary and a working Drive folder with the SCCs map.

Attachments: redlines-summary.pdf
Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cHelixDPA
DocuSign (placeholder): https://app.docusign.com/HelixMed/MSA-OrderForm-RN

Thanks — aiming to keep this light-touch so pilot can still target 8/2.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Strategic Accounts (West)
